name: NOFX
description: Self-hosted trading terminal in which LLMs make and execute trading decisions across multiple crypto exchanges.
whatItDoes: Lets traders configure AI-driven strategies, connect exchange accounts and watch positions and decisions in a dashboard. It trades real funds, so it carries real financial risk.
howItWorks: A Go backend runs the decision loop and exchange connectors, with a web front end on a local port. Model usage is paid from a funded wallet, and exchange credentials are entered in the app.

requirements.name: Exchange account
requirements.description: API access to a supported exchange such as Hyperliquid

requirements.name: Funded AI fee wallet
requirements.description: USDC balance used to pay for model calls

models: Multiple hosted LLMs through a pay-per-use gateway
